messages:
Maria: dropping a quick thread for the suppression panel accessibility pass. linked mock: https://figma.com/file/xyz :spiral_note_pad: Kevin: thanks. quick asks: keyboard flow, screen reader announcements, contrast and a short copy pass. Jess: I hit a focus trap when tabbing through channel chips inside the rules card (Chrome + VoiceOver). stuck inside the chips group. Oliver: that matches code — chips are inside a focusable wrapper `div[tabindex=0]`. we can instead render `ul > li > button.chip` and avoid the wrapper. Anya: i18n + a11y checklist incoming: focus order, visible focus ring, aria-labels for toggle and chips, aria-live for preview state. also contrast token check. Maria: copy question: current toggle says 'Preview suppression' 111 maybe we should use an action phrasing? Kevin: prefer action phrasing. 'Show suppression preview' or 'Show suppressed notifications' are clearer as toggle labels. Anya: accessibility specifics from my quick scan: - Contrast: chip text is 3.9:1, fails AA for normal text. need 4.5:1 or use bolder/larger text. - Focus ring: 2px subtle outline is low visibility on light gray chips. suggest 3px or using `focus-visible` color token. - SR announcements: when toggle enables, announce 'Suppression preview enabled. 3 channels muted.' via `aria-live=\"polite\"`. - Keyboard: chips must be reachable and actionable with Space/Enter. if purely decorative mark `aria-hidden=true`. Jess: FYI the wrapper was added to try to group chips for a11y, but it backfired. replacing with semantic list+buttons fixes both semantics and tab behavior. Oliver: adding `aria-pressed` to toggleable chips helps SR users know state. also add `title` attribute for truncated channel names. Kevin: copy for header: current 'Suppression preview (3 channels)'. suggestion: 'Preview: 3 channels will be suppressed' which reads as impact. Maria: agree with Kevin. 'Preview: 3 channels will be suppressed' it is. Anya: SR-only extra: include offscreen full sentence for screen readers like 'Preview enabled 1 messages from X channels will be muted until the suppression ends.' Jess: small snippet for aria-live area: ````html
Preview enabled: 3 channels muted
```` Oliver: also recommend `role=region` + `aria-labelledby` on the preview panel so SR users can jump to it easily. Anya: contrast fix options: swap to `bg-muted-600` + white text (5.2:1) or increase text size/weight per design tokens. whichever keeps visual hierarchy. Kevin: do badges inside the preview need tooltips for long channel names? Maria: yes, badges show in mock. add `title` and `aria-label` with full channel name. Jess: perf/a11y nit: when toggling preview we currently render many faux notifications. lazy-render visible subset and mark offscreen items `aria-hidden=true` so SRs aren't flooded. Anya: good call. also ensure the toggle is operable from nested focus via explicit key handlers for Space/Enter. Kevin: timeline: can we get a small PR with DOM + a11y + copy by EOW? Maria: I'll update figma copy and tokens. Jess/Oliver can you draft implementation? Oliver: will open PR to `feature/suppression-a11y` and link it. design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/412 3: build started. Jess: left two inline comments on the PR about removing the focus trap and adding aria-live. CSS focus ring suggestion included. Anya: I'll run a quick VoiceOver pass after PR merges. ping me in thread. Maria: follow-ups: @Jess fix DOM + focus, @Oliver add `role=region` + aria labels, @Kevin finalize copy. ping when PR is ready. :heart: Kevin: on it. Jess: will ship small changes today. Anya: will test once it's deployed to staging. Maria: thanks all 1 closing this review for now, will post updated mock and checklist when live.
